# BusinessDoctor
> Engineering Technology. Accelerating Digital Growth.

BusinessDoctor is an enterprise digital services practice delivering full-stack software development, performance digital marketing, UI/UX architecture, e-commerce marketplace scaling, creative video production, and cloud IT infrastructure.

## Core Practice Disciplines
- [SMO — Social Media Optimization](https://demo.businesdoctor.com/company/smo): Strategic profile optimization, bio conversion funnels, branded content templates, and viral reach frameworks across Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and X.
- [Google Business Profile Management](https://demo.businesdoctor.com/company/google-business-profile): Complete GBP setup, local map pack ranking optimization, review velocity management, geotagged photo updates, and spam fighting to capture high-intent local searchers.
- [PPC / Paid Ads](https://demo.businesdoctor.com/company/ppc-paid-ads): High-converting Google Search, Performance Max, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn B2B campaigns engineered to lower Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) and scale revenue.
- [Ecommerce Management](https://demo.businesdoctor.com/company/ecommerce-management): Full-lifecycle marketplace operations: Amazon & Flipkart store management, A+ premium content, catalog SEO, Buy Box defense, and automated multi-channel feeds.
- [Graphic Design](https://demo.businesdoctor.com/company/graphic-design): Corporate brand style guides, modern vector logos, high-impact marketing collateral, digital ad creatives, pitch decks, and custom infographics that command authority.
- [SEO — Search Engine Optimization](https://demo.businesdoctor.com/company/seo): Comprehensive technical SEO audits, sub-second Core Web Vitals, semantic content architecture, authoritative link building, and high-intent commercial keyword rankings.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://demo.businesdoctor.com/company/social-media-marketing): End-to-end social media strategy, high-engagement content calendars, community moderation, influencer partnerships, and full-funnel social advertising.
- [Product Photography](https://demo.businesdoctor.com/company/product-photography): High-resolution studio photography, pure white background e-commerce packs, 360-degree interactive product rotations, and aspirational lifestyle shoots tailored for conversion.
- [Video Editing](https://demo.businesdoctor.com/company/video-editing): Post-production video editing, high-energy short-form Reels & Shorts, corporate documentary videos, kinetic typography, 3D motion graphics, and audio mastering.
- [Web Development](https://demo.businesdoctor.com/company/web-development): Custom enterprise websites, scalable web applications, client portals, and secure database solutions engineered with modern PHP 8+, JavaScript, and sub-second Core Web Vitals.
